_comment: Rules of skill validate-valuation-assumptions. A rule computes only if its status is VERIFIED-REOPENED or ENGINEERING RULE; a [CHECK] rule is disabled and the script prints [CHECK].

rules.passage: Success-rate benchmarks are reported by stratum; a program above its benchmark stratum needs a stated reason.
Published sales forecasts have run high; no correction is applied, the comparison is flagged.
The valuer must document the method for the rate and provide evidence for its derivation.
Adjusting only the rate hides risk; the rate should not reflect the drug's own risk when probabilities are applied.
no registered threshold for a terminal-value share

rules.reason: the nine checks and their ok / flag / gap states are this skill's own set
rules.gap: no published checklist for valuation assumptions of a development-stage asset was located

rules.reason: the output states counts and that a named reviewer decides; it never calls a valuation validated (E_ADOPT on such a key)
